paragraphs.text: Nezahal , "the surging ocean," "the elder of the tides," is an aquatic elder dinosaur from Ixalan .
Nezahal has a long, whip-like body.

The opening of the golden city revealed the enormous elder dinosaurs , which were held in stasis during Orazca 's long hibernation in the earth. Each of these monsters embodies one aspect of the magic of the land: the aquatic Nezahal is a manifestation of blue mana and the devouring depths of the sea.
During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Nezahal and the other Elder Dinosaurs were summoned by Huatli to battle the intruders.
